fullDescription: Cinematic dark-warm hero section: a full-bleed dusk cityscape photo graded toward amber, layered with a warm sepia wash, an amber atmosphere bloom and a heavy vignette, under a translucent blurred sticky nav. Space Grotesk display + Inter body on near-black #0a0a0c with an amber #f0a868 accent and cream #f5f1ea text; a huge clamp headline with an amber gradient word, a live-showreel pill, an amber gradient CTA + ghost watch button, a trust row, and a bottom showreel control bar with a scroll cue.

structured.summary: A cinematic, dark-warm full-bleed hero section for an AI product-design agent ("Aurelio"). A dusk cityscape photograph is graded toward amber dusk and stacked with warm-tone, amber-bloom and dark-vignette overlay layers plus a faint film-grain, sitting under a translucent blurred sticky nav. Near-black ink base (#0a0a0c) with a single amber accent (#f0a868) and cream text (#f5f1ea). Type is Space Grotesk for display/UI and Inter for body. Top-down: a fixed glass nav (wordmark + center links + search/sign-in + a cream pill CTA); a top meta strip with a pulsing 'Live showreel' pill and a film timecode; the copy pushed to the lower third — an amber eyebrow with a short rule, a huge clamp headline ('Design at the speed of thought.') where 'thought.' is an amber gradient, a cream sub-paragraph, an amber gradient primary CTA + a ghost 'Watch the reel' button, and a trust row of three amber-check items; then a hairline and a bottom bar pairing a bobbing scroll cue (left) with showreel transport controls + a 01/03 progress readout (right).

style.description: Cinematic dark-warm 'dusk' aesthetic for a single full-bleed hero. A photographic city background is darkened and warmed (saturate ~1.16, contrast ~1.06, brightness ~0.62, scaled 1.08) then built up with four stacked full-bleed layers: a warm sepia gradient wash on soft-light blend, a radial amber 'sun-burst' atmosphere bloom on screen blend anchored behind the headline, a dark cinematic grade (top/bottom darkening + a left copy-scrim + a radial vignette), and a faint SVG fractal-noise film grain on overlay blend so flat areas don't band. Near-black ink base #0a0a0c; a single warm amber accent #f0a868 (with lighter #ffd9a8 and deeper #d97b3a / #e08b46 / #c46028 stops for gradients) over cream text #f5f1ea at varying opacities. Space Grotesk (700/600/500) for headings, the wordmark, eyebrows and buttons with very tight -0.035em headline tracking and 0.92 line-height; Inter for body and microcopy. Translucent glass nav (backdrop blur+saturate over rgba(10,10,12,0.32)), soft text-shadows on overlay text for legibility, amber CTA glow shadows, and an amber selection color. Mood: premium, filmic, confident, warm-dark — never flat or generic.
style.prompt: Design a single full-bleed cinematic dark-warm hero section. Palette: background ink #0a0a0c (also a near-black #07060 8 / rgba(7,6,8,*) for scrims), one warm amber accent #f0a868 (lighter highlight #ffd9a8, deeper stops #d97b3a / #e08b46 / #c46028), cream text #f5f1ea used at 100/85/80/75/60/55% opacity. Fonts: Space Grotesk (400/500/600/700) for all display, the wordmark, eyebrows, buttons and uppercase labels; Inter (400/500/600) for body copy and microcopy. Headlines: font-700, letter-spacing -0.035em, line-height 0.92, clamp(2.7rem, 9.2vw, 6.6rem), with one phrase as a left-to-right amber->#ffd9a8 bg-clip-text gradient. Build the cinematic grade by stacking full-bleed layers over a single scaled (1.08) photographic city background filtered to dusk (saturate 1.16, contrast 1.06, brightness 0.62; darker on narrow viewports): (1) a warm sepia linear wash (rgba(120,52,18,.34)->(140,66,24,.20)->(60,24,8,.40)) on mix-blend soft-light; (2) an amber atmosphere bloom — radial(255,193,120,.62) core + radial(196,96,40,.34) — on mix-blend screen, anchored ~44%/52% behind the headline; (3) a dark grade = a 180deg top+bottom darkening gradient + a 90deg left copy-scrim + a 135% radial vignette, all in ink/near-black; (4) a faint SVG feTurbulence fractalNoise film grain at opacity .05 on mix-blend overlay. Add soft text-shadows (0 2px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.55)) on the overlaid eyebrow/headline/body. Buttons: a primary amber pill = linear-gradient(180deg,#f0a868,#e08b46) with dark #0a0a0c text and an amber glow (box-shadow 0 12px 40px -10px rgba(240,168,104,.55) + inset top highlight), lifting -2px with stronger glow on hover; a ghost pill = white/25 hairline border over white/4 fill, brightening on hover. Nav is glass: rgba(10,10,12,.32) with backdrop-blur(14px) saturate(140%) and a white/10 bottom border. Use an amber text-selection. Keep it premium, filmic and warm-dark; the amber is the single accent and the photo grade carries the mood.

layout_and_structure.description: One full-bleed hero section (min-height 100svh, overflow hidden, flex column) with all foreground content centered in a max-w-[1240px] container with px-6/px-8 gutters. Layer order bottom-up: the scaled photo, the warm-tone wash, the amber bloom, the dark grade, a narrow-viewport copy-scrim (off at >=lg), then the film grain; foreground sits at z-10. Vertical flow: a fixed glass sticky header (h-68px) overlapping the top; just under it a top meta strip (pulsing 'Live showreel' pill on the left, film timecode on the right, hidden on mobile); a flex-1 spacer that pushes the copy down to the lower third like a film still; the overlay copy block (max-w-[860px]): an amber uppercase eyebrow with a short rule, the huge clamp headline with a gradient word, a max-w-[560px] cream sub-paragraph, a CTA row (amber gradient primary + ghost watch button, stacking on mobile), and a wrap-friendly trust row of three amber-check items; then a full-width hairline divider and a bottom bar that splits a bobbing scroll cue (left) from showreel transport controls + a 01/03 progress readout (right, hidden on mobile). Responsive: nav center links and the right search/sign-in collapse below lg/sm, the headline line-break and clamp scale down, CTAs stack, the photo is darkened harder at <=1023px and <=480px and the copy-scrim turns on so body text stays legible over the bright window band.

prompts.prompt: A fixed top header (z-50) spanning full width with a glass background (rgba(10,10,12,0.32) + backdrop-blur(14px) saturate(140%)) and a white/10 bottom border. Inside a max-w-[1240px] row at h-[68px], items justified between: left = a wordmark — a 26px rounded-8px amber gradient (amber->#d97b3a) badge with a soft amber blur glow behind it holding a dark ph:sparkle-fill icon, next to 'Aurelio' in Space Grotesk 700 ~19px tight tracking; center (hidden below lg) = five Inter ~14px cream/75 links (Showreel, Library, Canvas, Pricing, Docs) brightening to full cream on hover; right = a search link (ph:magnifying-glass icon + 'Search', hidden on small), a thin white/15 divider, a 'Sign in' text link, and a solid cream pill CTA 'Start free' (dark text, ph:arrow-up-right-bold icon) that brightens to white on hover.

A z-10 strip just under the nav (pt-[68px] then pt-7/pt-9) inside max-w-[1240px], justified between. Left: a rounded-full pill with a white/15 border over black/30 backdrop-blur holding a pulsing amber status dot (an animate-ping amber ring behind a solid amber dot) and Inter ~12.5px cream/85 text 'Live showreel · 2,400+ designs generated today'. Right (hidden below md): a ph:film-strip icon + uppercase wide-tracked cream/55 timecode '00:14 / 02:38'.
A flex-1 spacer (min-h-[16vh]) between the meta strip and the copy block so the headline content sits in the lower third of the frame, like the lower-left title card of a cinematic still.

A z-10 block inside max-w-[1240px] with pb-12/pb-16, content constrained to max-w-[860px]. Top: an amber Space Grotesk 500 uppercase eyebrow (~12.5-13px, 0.34em tracking) preceded by a short 8px amber/70 rule, reading 'The AI product design agent', with a soft text-shadow. Then the headline in Space Grotesk 700 cream with text-shadow, clamp(2.7rem,9.2vw,6.6rem), letter-spacing -0.035em, line-height 0.92: 'Design at the' / (sm line-break) 'speed of ' + 'thought.' where 'thought.' is a left-to-right amber->#ffd9a8 bg-clip-text transparent gradient. Below, a max-w-[560px] Inter ~16-18.5px cream/80 sub-paragraph with text-shadow ('Describe the interface in plain words. Aurelio renders real mockups, components, and full layouts on an infinite canvas, straight from a prompt or your coding agent.'). Then a CTA row (mt-9, column on mobile / row on sm): the amber gradient primary pill 'Generate your first UI' (ph:arrow-right-bold) and the ghost pill 'Watch the reel' (amber ph:play-circle-fill icon). Then a trust row (mt-9, flex-wrap) of three Inter ~13px cream/60 items each with an amber/90 ph:check-circle-fill icon: 'No credit card', 'Works in Claude Code & Cursor', 'Export to clean code'.

Inside max-w-[1240px], a full-width hairline divider (a 1px transparent->cream/22->transparent horizontal gradient) above a py-5 bar justified between. Left: a scroll cue — a 22px-wide rounded 'mouse' capsule with a white/30 border holding a bobbing (keyframe translateY) amber dot, next to Inter ~12px uppercase 0.22em cream/60 'Scroll to explore', brightening on hover. Right (hidden below sm): showreel transport controls in cream/65 — a 36px circular hairline 'Pause' button (ph:pause-fill), a 3-segment progress indicator (one wide amber bar + two short white/25 bars), and a tabular-nums uppercase '01 / 03' readout.

special_ui_components.prompt: Cinematic photo grade: a single scaled (1.08) city photo filtered to dusk (saturate 1.16 / contrast 1.06 / brightness 0.62, darker at <=1023px and <=480px) under four stacked full-bleed overlay layers
Warm-tone wash: a 180deg warm sepia linear gradient (rgba(120,52,18,.34) -> (140,66,24,.20) -> (60,24,8,.40)) on mix-blend-mode soft-light
Amber atmosphere bloom: a radial 'sun-burst' (rgba(255,193,120,.62) core + rgba(196,96,40,.34)) on mix-blend-mode screen, anchored ~44%/52% behind the headline
Dark cinematic grade: a 180deg top+bottom darkening gradient + a 90deg left copy-scrim + a 135% radial vignette, all in ink / near-black, for the filmic falloff
Film grain overlay: an inline SVG feTurbulence fractalNoise pattern at opacity 0.05 on mix-blend-mode overlay so flat sky/shadow areas don't band
Narrow-viewport copy-scrim: a bottom-up + radial near-black gradient under the text column, displayed only below lg, that darkens the bright window band so body copy stays readable
Glass sticky nav: rgba(10,10,12,0.32) with backdrop-blur(14px) saturate(140%) and a white/10 hairline bottom border
Amber gradient pill CTA with glow: linear-gradient(180deg,#f0a868,#e08b46), dark #0a0a0c text, box-shadow amber glow + inset top highlight, -2px hover lift; paired with a hairline ghost button
bg-clip-text amber gradient on the headline accent word ('thought.', amber -> #ffd9a8)
Pulsing 'Live showreel' status pill (animate-ping amber ring + solid amber dot) and a film timecode (ph:film-strip)
Showreel transport bar: a circular hairline pause button, a 3-segment progress indicator, an '01 / 03' tabular-nums readout, and a bobbing scroll-cue 'mouse' capsule (CSS keyframe)
Phosphor (Iconify ph:*) icons throughout: sparkle-fill, magnifying-glass, arrow-up-right-bold, film-strip, arrow-right-bold, play-circle-fill, check-circle-fill, pause-fill

structured.special_notes: Fonts loaded from Google Fonts: Space Grotesk (400/500/600/700, display + UI + buttons + eyebrows) and Inter (400/500/600, body + microcopy). Styled with Tailwind via CDN using a custom theme: colors base #0a0a0c, amber #f0a868, cream #f5f1ea; fontFamily display = Space Grotesk, sans = Inter. Iconify (ph:* / Phosphor set). The section is a single full-bleed hero (min-height 100svh, overflow-hidden) — the entire mood is carried by the four stacked overlay layers over one photo, so swap the photo but keep the warm-tone + amber-bloom + dark-grade + grain stack and the amber/cream/ink palette. On narrow viewports the photo is darkened harder and the copy-scrim turns on so the lower-third copy keeps >=4.5:1 contrast over the sun-lit window band. Keep the single-amber-accent discipline: amber for the eyebrow, the headline accent word, the primary CTA, the status dot and the check icons; everything else is cream-on-ink. In the original the background is a local hero photo; in this self-contained artifact it is inlined as a base64 data URI.
